# below-ten

Nine RTX 3090 asks on their own (£600 to £680). Every listing is positioned and stamped T4, but the
user-facing view returns no row, because n = 9 is below the owner's n >= 10
(nabvy/docs/decisions.md:15; fb-scrap-engine/docs/design/SELLER_DATA.md:329). The lowest ask is
rank 1, (0 + 0.5) / 9 = 5.6%.
